job.title: Sr. Data Scientist, Performance Marketing
job.workplace: Remote in the US; in office 1–2 times a quarter
job.pay_full: $139,764 – $287,749 a year base salary (US), plus equity

details.about: Millions of people come to Pinterest for creative ideas and inspiration. This Senior Data Scientist joins the Growth Marketing team in Pinterest's marketing org, supporting the performance marketing that drives user growth. The role brings more scientific rigor to marketing measurement and optimization, and its results inform company decisions on growth investment, user behavior and the metrics used to grow and keep users. You'll work with Marketing, Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Product Analytics and Data Engineering.
duties: Answer strategic growth marketing questions, such as how paid performance marketing drives monthly active users, engagement and lifetime value, and its effect in new markets
Evolve geo-testing and other incrementality testing frameworks
Build and deploy statistical and machine learning models (propensity, forecasting, lifetime value) to optimize marketing and audience targeting
Develop and improve models such as user lifetime value, budgeting and long-term retention models
Evolve experimentation tools and advise on experimentation best practices
Define success metrics and own them from logging requirements to pipelines
Turn complex findings into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership
Build dashboards, automated reporting and ETL pipelines
needs: At least 5 years of combined post-graduate academic and industry experience applying scientific methods to real-world problems
Master's degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, computer science or engineering
Hands-on experience building marketing measurement solutions
Strong background in statistics and quantitative analysis
Expertise in at least one scripting language (ideally Python or R)
Strong business and product sense and excellent communication
A strong experimentation background and experience with causal inference
details.benefits: Base salary $139,764 – $287,749 (US-based applicants only); final salary depends on location, travel, experience and skills. The position is also eligible for equity.
notes: Can be based anywhere in the US, with in-office collaboration 1–2 times a quarter
